description: Load the Oswego outbreak dataset in Epi Info 7 Classic Analysis. Recode the 'Age' variable into a new variable 'AgeGroup' with four categories: '0-19', '20-39', '40-59', and '60+'. Then, aggregate/summarize the data to count the number of cases by AgeGroup and Illness status (Ill). Finally, export the resulting summary table to a CSV file named 'AgeIllnessSummary.csv' in 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\'. The CSV must contain columns for AgeGroup, Ill, and the Count/Frequency.
